summary: Temporary accommodation is not a 'bostad'. The dwelling-design rules (BFS 2024:11) and the dwelling-specific accessibility, daylight and sound rules therefore do not apply; Boverket states this explicitly for hotels and temporary accommodation, even when rooms have full home facilities. A hotel is a 'lokal' (and, where the public enters, a 'publik lokal'). It gets functional requirements: daylight and outlook in rooms used more than temporarily 'unless unreasonable' (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 §), noise control as the use requires (BFS 2024:10 2 kap. 9 §), and general accessibility (PBL 8 kap. 1 § 3; BFS 2024:12), with a hearing loop in receptions. Guest rooms are fire class Vk 4 and each is its own fire compartment (BFS 2024:7). No law sets room size or the number of accessible rooms; practice cited in a 2023 municipal permit file is at least 1 accessible room per 10. The police permit for hotel and boarding-house businesses (Lag 1966:742, >= 9 guests or >= 5 rooms) was repealed on 1 January 2025. Staff areas follow AFS 2023:12. Planning use is 'Tillfällig vistelse', not 'Bostäder'.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: 4 — guest rooms, dormitories and similar in hotels, hostels, B&B and other temporary accommodation (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 17 §); each guest room / dormitory its own fire compartment (5 kap. 25 § p. 7). Restaurant/breakfast room: Vk 2A (<= 150 persons) or 2B (> 150) (2 kap. 11-12 §§); 2C if > 150 persons and alcohol served more than to a limited extent (2 kap. 13 §). Back-of-house offices: Vk 1. A commercial kitchen with special fire risk must be its own compartment (5 kap. 26 §).

permits: Bygglov for change of use from office: PBL 9 kap. 15 § p. 1.
Detaljplan must allow 'Tillfällig vistelse' (Boverket planbestämmelse; includes staff areas and complementary restaurant, conference, spa, gym).
Food: a food business must be registered with the municipal food control authority before start (EU Regulation 852/2004 art. 6; Livsmedelsverket guidance). Not verified in this pass.
Alcohol serving licence (serveringstillstånd, alkohollagen 2010:1622) from the municipality, if alcohol is served. Not verified in this pass.
No police permit since 1 Jan 2025 (Lag 1966:742 repealed).
regulatory.operator_oversight: Municipality (byggnadsnämnd; miljö-/livsmedelskontroll for food; räddningstjänst for fire safety under LSO). Arbetsmiljöverket for staff areas.

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Working value: gross floor area per key incl. lobby, breakfast and back-of-house. Lower end for economy/limited service, upper for full service. No Swedish source found; MUST be verified against operator briefs.

staff_per_unit.source: Working value for limited-service hotels (staff present per room at peak); full service much higher. Unsourced.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Share of room capacity with guests present, assuming about 65-70 % average room occupancy and an average 1.3-1.5 guests per occupied room. Indicative, unsourced. Breakfast peak 06:30-09:30, check-in peak 15:00-19:00.
occupancy.persons_per_dwelling_note: Beds per room: standard double 2, single 1; family rooms 3-4. Design guests per room about 1.5 (indicative).

required.basis: Core function. Fire: Vk 4, own fire compartment (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 17 §, 5 kap. 25 § p. 7). Daylight and outlook: BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 § (rooms in lokaler where people stay more than temporarily must have enough daylight and outlook, unless unreasonable). Noise: BFS 2024:10 2 kap. 9 § (sound insulation, impact sound, installation and traffic noise, reverberation as the use requires).

size.source: No law sets room size. Working value (net incl. bathroom); budget/micro hotels go below 14 m². Unsourced.

spaces.notes: No numeric DF for lokaler (the 1.0 % rule is dwelling-only), which gives hotels more freedom than housing in deep office plans. Whether a hotel guest room counts as 'vistas mer än tillfälligt' was not tested. Acoustic design is typically done to SS 25268 (sound classes for lokaler); edition not checked.

required.basis: Not required by building law for temporary accommodation (BFS 2024:11 does not apply); market standard for hotels. Hostels may use shared bathrooms.

spaces.notes: In office conversions, a wet room per key is the main services cost, as for studios.

required.basis: PBL 8 kap. 1 § p. 3 and BFS 2024:12 (buildings must be accessible and usable; publik lokal dimensions: wheelchair 0.70 x 1.30 m, turning circle 1.50 m, door >= 0.80 m, 1 kap. 6 §). The law sets no share of accessible rooms.

size.source: Accessibility statement in Nacka bygglov file (hotel Rösunda 27:2, 2023): 'Tidigare byggregler rekommenderade minst ett tillgängligt rum per 10 gästrum'. The original rule it refers to was not identified.

spaces.notes: Use the publik lokal turning circle of 1.50 m (not the 1.30 m dwelling value), since the hotel is not a dwelling.

required.basis: Operational need (self-check-in concepts can minimise it). If a reception exists, a hearing loop is law: BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 § ('I samlingssalar och receptioner ska system för ljudöverföring till hörhjälpmedel finnas').

spaces.shareable_note: Lobby/lounge can double as café or co-working.

spaces.label_en: Public toilets (incl. at least one accessible)

required.basis: BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 § and 3 kap. 7 §: if there are toilets for the public in a publik lokal, at least one must be accessible, with turning space and side transfer on both sides

size.source: No m² in BFS 2024:12 (turning circle 1.50 m governs).

required.basis: Not required by law; standard service. Fire class 2A/2B/2C by size and alcohol (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11-13 §§).

size.count: seats about 40-60 % of beds (working value, unsourced)
size.source: No source found for m² per seat; do not copy Neufert tables.

spaces.shareable_note: Breakfast mornings only; can run as a public restaurant or café the rest of the day.

required.basis: Required only if food is prepared on site; food business registration (EU 852/2004; municipal food control). Commercial kitchen with special fire risk = own fire compartment (BFS 2024:7 5 kap. 26 §); grease ducts with secured fire resistance (4 kap. 24 §).

spaces.notes: Grease exhaust routing to roof is the usual blocker in an existing building.

spaces.label_en: Staff facilities (changing rooms, toilets, eating, break and rest)

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 37-65 §§: changing room where work is soiling or work clothes are used (46-49 §§), enough toilets and washbasins (56 §), eating space with tables and chairs, fridge, means to heat food and wash up (60-61 §§), break space (62 §), rest space for lying down (63 §)

size.count: toilets: generally one per started group of 15 employees (AFS 2023:12 general advice to 3 kap. 56 §); separate rest room typically when > 50 persons are employed at the same time (advice to 63 §)
size.source: AFS 2023:12 allmänna råd. An accessible toilet should be at least 2.2 x 2.2 m (advice to 58 §). No m² for changing or eating rooms.

spaces.notes: Detailed general workplace rules are in data/catalogue/cross_cutting.json; only hotel-specific counts are noted here. Housekeeping staff do soiling work, so changing rooms with showers are effectively needed.

spaces.label_en: Housekeeping stores, linen room, laundry (or outsourced linen)

required.basis: Operational; floor pantries on each floor are usual. Not law.

size.count: one floor pantry per guest floor plus central store

required.basis: Operational for housekeeping and luggage; not law. Accessible lift requirements (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 5 §) apply to the guest lift.

spaces.label_en: Accessible entrance, corridors and guest lift

required.basis: BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 1-2 §§, 5 § (accessible main entrance and circulation; lift short side >= 1100 mm; level difference > 1 m needs a lift)

size.source: Lift dimension is law; corridor width is functional.

spaces.notes: Guests are sleeping and unfamiliar with the building (Vk 4), so egress and alarm design is stricter than for Vk 1 offices.

required.basis: Optional; if used as samlingslokal, BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 § (hearing loop in samlingssalar) and Vk 2A/2B apply.

spaces.shareable_note: Existing office meeting rooms can be kept.

size.count: per municipal waste rules; food waste from kitchen may need a cooled room

required.basis: BFS 2026:4 2 kap. 4 §: a new lokalbyggnad must have bicycle parking for at least 15 % of average or 10 % of total user capacity; may be adapted where people normally do not arrive by bike. On alteration only for ombyggnad involving car parking (1 kap. 4 §).

size.count: >= 15 % of average or 10 % of total user capacity (guests + staff)

spaces.notes: Also EV charging if more than 5 car spaces (BFS 2026:4 2 kap. 3 §).

variants.label: Limited-service / budget hotel
variants.changes: Small rooms (about 14-18 m²), breakfast only, minimal reception or self-check-in, no conference. Lower gross m² per key (indicative).

variants.label: Full-service hotel
variants.changes: Restaurant and bar (Vk 2B/2C when > 150 persons), conference, spa/gym; larger back-of-house; higher staff ratio.

variants.label: Aparthotel / extended-stay
variants.changes: Rooms of about 25-40 m² (indicative) with kitchenette, no or small restaurant, guest laundry. Still temporary accommodation: Vk 4, BFS 2024:11 does not apply (Boverket: a hotel is not a dwelling even with full home facilities). If units are let on tenancy contracts as permanent homes, the use becomes 'Bostäder' and all dwelling rules apply (daylight 1.0 %, sound tables, dwelling accessibility).

variants.label: Hostel (vandrarhem)
variants.changes: Dormitories and shared bathrooms; each dormitory its own fire compartment (Vk 4); communal guest kitchen.

typical_blockers: Fire: Vk 1 to Vk 4 (sleeping, unfamiliar occupants), with each room its own compartment, alarm and egress upgrades.
Wet room per key: drainage through slabs.
typical_enablers: No dwelling DF 1.0 % rule and no dwelling sound tables, so deeper rooms are possible than for housing (functional requirements still apply).
No friyta requirement (PBL 8 kap. 9 § second paragraph covers dwellings and schools, not hotels).
Office lobbies, lifts, meeting rooms and parking map well to hotel needs.
Fast route: no police permit since 2025.

open_questions: Accessible room share: the '1 per 10 rooms' figure comes from a consultant statement citing 'earlier building rules'. Identify the original (likely pre-2008 BBR or ALM general advice) or a current operator/industry standard (e.g. Visita).
Does BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 § (daylight/outlook in lokaler where people stay more than temporarily) cover hotel guest rooms? Boverket guidance on this paragraph was not read.
Room size, gross m² per key, breakfast seats per bed and staff ratios are unsourced working values. Need operator briefs (e.g. Scandic, Nordic Choice brand standards) or Visita data.
Food registration and serveringstillstånd were stated from general knowledge, not fetched. Verify with Livsmedelsverket and the alkohollag before relying on them.
LSO: does a hotel need a written fire-safety statement (skriftlig redogörelse) under MSB rules? Not checked.
Is guest registration still required after Lag 1966:742 was repealed? Not checked.
Aparthotel to housing boundary: no case law or Boverket guidance checked beyond the 'Tillfällig vistelse' page.
